fields.title: Fields
fields.description: HL7 field numbers to mask, per segment (e.g. {"PID": [3, 5]} masks PID-3 and PID-5).

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: JSON keys and XML element names whose values are masked wherever they appear.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: JSON and XML paths to mask: a FHIR resource type, * for any resource, or $ for the document root, then element names separated by dots (Patient.name, *.text.div, $.patient.ssn).

400.description: A segment name, field number, key name, or path is invalid.

403.description: Requires the Security settings and Unredact PHI permissions.
